In the MBA program, he teaches in the Required Core Strategy course as well as elective courses on Ownership and Leading a Family Business. He also teaches in several executive education programs, including Owner/President Management, Family Office Wealth Management, and Families in Business. He was a Faculty Cochair for Family Office Wealth Management. He was formerly an Adjunct Professor at Colum
